source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: No hole map found; the Links is taken to be the 18 holes south of the road across from the clubhouse (the Lakes course to the north is traced separately). Hole order and direction are worked out from the photo and the card's pars and lengths only, so every hole number is a best guess.
unsure.4: Par 3 over the pond from the tees on its west bank; another set of tees on the east bank (about 170 yd) may be the real back tee.
unsure.7: Placed from the tee east of the lake arm to the bunkered green in the south-east corner; traced about 230 yd against the card's 355, so the hole may start further back or be a different green.
unsure.8: Par 3 from the row of tees along the north-east edge to the big two-lobed green; that green could instead be a practice green.
unsure.9: Tee placed east of the small pond near the maintenance area, played over it and north up the fairway to the green by the road; the tee walk from the 8th green is a guess.
unsure.11: Tee placed by the 17th green west of the subdivision road; traced about 500 yd against the card's 552.
unsure.12: The darker patch with a bunker at the south end of this fairway is taken as the green; it could be a lay-up area of a par 5 to the next green.
unsure.13: Par 3 across the waste area to the big green by the south road; back tee position is a guess.
unsure.18: Tee placed in the waste area between the road and the 10th green; the card's back tee (430 yd) is further than the tees seen.
